news.headline: A $500M redemption is planned as FTAI Aviation (FTAI)'s subsidiary prices new debt.
news.summary: Subsidiary FTAI Aviation Investors LLC priced its $1.0 billion private offering of 7.125% senior unsecured notes due 2034 at par, with interest accruing from November 6. Proceeds will repay the revolver drawn for the accelerated share repurchase and redeem $500 million of the 5.50% senior notes due 2028.

news.headline: FTAI Aviation Subsidiary Launches $1 Billion Senior Notes Offering Due 2034
news.summary: Subsidiary FTAI Aviation Investors LLC launched a private offering of $1.0bn senior unsecured notes due 2034 to repay the revolver drawn for the accelerated share repurchase and redeem part of the 5.50% notes due 2028. Fitch assigned the new notes a BB- rating and affirmed existing debt.

news.headline: FTAI Aviation (NASDAQ:FTAI) Shares Climb 7.6% - Still a Buy?
news.summary: FTAI rebounded roughly 7-8% on November 2 with unusually high options volume, recovering part of its post-earnings pullback as the debt refinancing plan was announced.

news.headline: FTAI Maintained by RBC Capital -- Price Target Raised to $265
news.summary: RBC Capital kept its rating on FTAI and lifted its price target to $265 following the Q3 report, one of several post-earnings target moves as analysts digested the buyback and reaffirmed guidance.

news.headline: FTAI Aviation Ltd. Reports Strong Third Quarter 2026 Performance and Announces $500.0 Million Accelerated Share Repurchase
news.summary: Q3 revenue rose 46.6% y/y to $977.7M and adjusted EBITDA hit a record $348.3M (+17%), led by Aerospace Products (+76%); 2026/2027 EBITDA guidance was reaffirmed. The board doubled the buyback authorization to $1.0bn, with $500M executed immediately via an ASR, and shares jumped ~14% despite a slight EPS/revenue miss.

news.headline: FTAI and United Airlines Expand Engine Exchange Program to CFM56-7B
news.summary: FTAI and United signed a multi-year maintenance, repair and exchange agreement that extends their existing V2500 engine-exchange relationship to CFM56-7B engines powering United's 737NG fleet. Financial terms were not disclosed, but it deepens FTAI's flagship Aerospace Products franchise with a major U.S. carrier.

catalysts.label: Closing of $1B 7.125% 2034 notes and partial redemption of 2028 notes
catalysts.detail: The $1.0 billion 7.125% senior notes due 2034 (Fitch BB-) were priced at par with interest from November 6, the expected settlement date. Proceeds repay the revolver drawn for the $500M ASR and fund the redemption of $500 million of the 5.50% notes due 2028, for which a separate redemption notice is still to come.

catalysts.label: $500M accelerated share repurchase settlement
catalysts.detail: The $500M ASR launched with the Q3 report under the doubled $1.0bn authorization; final settlement will set the total share-count reduction.

catalysts.label: Investor meeting in New York
catalysts.detail: Scheduled investor meeting; a likely venue for 2027 guidance and an update on the asset-light SPV strategy and FTAI Power.

catalysts.label: Q4/FY2026 results
catalysts.detail: Full-year report should show whether FTAI landed within its reaffirmed 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance and give the first quarterly read on the ASR's share-count impact.

catalysts.label: FTAI Power Mod-1 first deliveries
catalysts.detail: CEO Joe Adams said the Mod-1 cleared its critical testing milestones ahead of first deliveries next year, against the $1.465bn hyperscaler order.

pulse: As of November 3, 2026, FTAI is building on its October 29 Q3 report (record adjusted EBITDA of $348.3M, revenue +46.6%, reaffirmed 2026/2027 guidance) and a $500M accelerated buyback within a doubled $1.0bn authorization, with RBC lifting its target to $265. On November 2 its subsidiary priced $1.0bn of 7.125% notes due 2034 to refinance the ASR-funding revolver and redeem $500M of 2028 notes, and shares rebounded about 7-8% after a valuation-driven pullback to roughly $187. Next up are the notes closing around November 6, ASR settlement, the December 10 investor meeting and first FTAI Power Mod-1 deliveries in 2027.
